overview: A hiring and onboarding roster app for a store team, with roadie and leader cards, crews, training groups, paperwork tracking and opening questions.
features: Open a leader's or roadie's full profile from any card pop-up
Managing Partner and Admins can open every full profile
Back button returns to the list after opening a full profile
Roadie and leader cards with tiers and About Me details
Crews, training groups and paperwork tracking
